# gyro_load_balancer (Resource)

A Gyro Cloud load balancer (managed L4/L7, EU regions). Creating one places an order paid from the account balance (confirm_order must be true). services and targets are authoritative when set: anything else on the load balancer is removed; leave them unset to manage them elsewhere (panel, CLI). Destroying cancels the service; traffic stops at once and the load balancer is destroyed after the grace period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Two cloud servers behind a managed load balancer (EU regions: eu-de-1, eu-de-2, eu-fi-1).
resource "gyro_server" "web" {
  count         = 2
  plan          = "standart-2-4"
  region        = "eu-de-1"
  image         = "ubuntu-24.04"
  hostname      = "web-${count.index + 1}.example.com"
  confirm_order = true
}

resource "gyro_load_balancer" "web" {
  size          = "small" # small | medium | large (GET /cloud/load-balancer-types)
  region        = "eu-de-1"
  algorithm     = "least_connections"
  confirm_order = true # creating a load balancer is a paid order from your account balance

  services = [
    {
      protocol         = "http"
      listen_port      = 80
      destination_port = 80
      sticky_sessions  = true
      health_check     = { protocol = "http", path = "/healthz", interval = 10, timeout = 5, retries = 3 }
    },
    {
      # TLS passthrough: certificates stay on the servers
      protocol         = "tcp"
      listen_port      = 443
      destination_port = 443
    },
  ]

  targets = [for s in gyro_server.web : { type = "server", server_id = tonumber(s.id) }]
}

output "load_balancer_ip" {
  value = gyro_load_balancer.web.ipv4 # point your A record here
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `confirm_order` (Boolean) Must be true: creating a load balancer spends account balance.
- `size` (String) small, medium or large (see GET /cloud/load-balancer-types). Changing it replaces the load balancer.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) round_robin (default) or least_connections.
- `cycle` (String) Billing cycle: monthly (default), quarterly, semiannually, annually.
- `delete_immediately` (Boolean) destroy cancels at once (default). false = file a cancellation request instead.
- `project_id` (Number) Project of the load balancer (gyro_project id, 0 = default project). Set at order time; changing it later moves the load balancer in place.
- `region` (String) eu-de-1 (default), eu-de-2 or eu-fi-1. Targets must be cloud servers in an EU region. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `services` (Attributes List) Listeners, keyed by listen_port. HTTPS needs certificate_ids of certificates on this load balancer (upload or Let's Encrypt from the panel/API). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `targets` (Attributes List) Targets: your cloud servers (server_id = gyro_server id, same EU region), all your cloud servers (type all), or your dedicated server IPs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Price currency.
- `due_date` (String) Next due date.
- `id` (String) Load balancer id (service id in the client area).
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address (point your A record here).
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `name` (String) Load balancer name.
- `price` (Number) Recurring price per cycle (VAT excluded).
- `status` (String) Service status (active, suspended, ...).

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Required:

- `destination_port` (Number) Port on the targets.
- `listen_port` (Number) Port the load balancer listens on.
- `protocol` (String) tcp, http or https.

Optional:

- `certificate_ids` (List of Number) HTTPS: certificate ids of this load balancer.
- `cookie_lifetime` (Number) Sticky session cookie lifetime (s).
- `cookie_name` (String) Sticky session cookie name.
- `health_check` (Attributes) Health check; defaults: TCP for tcp, HTTP GET / for http/https, 15 s interval, 10 s timeout, 3 retries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--health_check))
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Idle timeout (s, http/https).
- `proxyprotocol` (Boolean) Send the PROXY protocol header to targets.
- `redirect_http` (Boolean) HTTPS: redirect port 80 to HTTPS (port 80 must not have its own service).
- `sticky_sessions` (Boolean) Sticky sessions (http/https).

<a id="nestedatt--services--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services.health_check`

Optional:

- `domain` (String) HTTP Host header.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks (3-60).
- `path` (String) HTTP path (starts with /).
- `port` (Number) Port to check (default destination_port).
- `protocol` (String) tcp or http.
- `retries` (Number) Failed checks before a target is unhealthy (0-5).
- `status_codes` (List of String) Accepted HTTP codes, e.g. ["2??", "3??"].
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds before a check fails (1-30, below interval).
- `tls` (Boolean) HTTP check over TLS.



<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `type` (String) server, all or ip.

Optional:

- `ip` (String) Dedicated server IP (type ip).
- `server_id` (Number) gyro_server id (type server).
- `use_private_ip` (Boolean) Reach the target over the private network (attach one in the panel/API first).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Load balancers are imported by their numeric id.
terraform import gyro_load_balancer.web 47561
```
